_zweck: Closed vocabulary for preset descriptions (presets/ENTSCHEIDUNGEN.md, P-V1..P-V6). Validation rejects every word not listed here. Changing any list is a deliberate edit: raise version, append a verlauf entry and set pruefsumme (node presets/werkzeug.ts pruefsumme prints it).

verlauf.aenderung: First vocabulary: kinds and sub-kinds for instruments and effects, character, genre, use, energy 1..5

Character words checked against the sound-vocabulary study: dropped loose, organic, gritty, glassy, static (no source), heavy (loudness or size, not timbre), analog, digital (origin, not timbre; analog stays a sub-kind of bass and pad); added bedeutung with meaning, measure, move and source per word; warm means fullness around 100-200 Hz

warm.sinn: Fullness in the low mids: more body around 100-200 Hz (the product owner's usage, 2026-11-02; research also uses warm for fewer highs, which is not meant here).
warm.messgroesse: Energy share 100-200 Hz relative to the whole spectrum; on bass the ratio of 120-200 Hz to 80-120 Hz.
warm.eingriff: Low mids up: bell or low shelf +2 to +4 dB around 100-200 Hz; if too warm, cut there or at 80-120 Hz.
warm.beleg: Andreas 2026-11-02; Owsinski, Glossary and bass EQ section

bright.sinn: Energy concentrated toward the top of the spectrum.
bright.messgroesse: Spectral centroid; share of high-frequency energy; for percussion, centroid during the attack.
bright.eingriff: high-shelf up / low-shelf down; low-pass down to darken.

dark.sinn: The opposite pole of bright: energy in the lower partials, little upper-spectrum content.
dark.messgroesse: Low spectral centroid, negative luminance loading.
dark.eingriff: high-shelf down, low-pass down; almost never a boost.

punchy.sinn: Dynamics reproduced with a hard, strong impact.
punchy.messgroesse: Crest factor / transient (attack); Owsinski also names energy at 200 Hz and 5 kHz.
punchy.eingriff: transient shaper or compressor with slower attack and fast release; slight boost at 200 Hz and 5 kHz.

soft.sinn: Low in high-partial energy; the gentle pole opposite rough/harsh.
soft.messgroesse: Negative loading on the texture dimension; lower spectral centroid.
soft.eingriff: high-shelf down, low-pass down; gentler dynamics (slower attack).

wide.sinn: Stereo image that extends toward the sides instead of sitting in the centre.
wide.messgroesse: Inter-channel level/time differences; amount of opposed panning.
wide.eingriff: pan parts hard L/R (opposition panning), M/S widener, short Haas delay; always re-check in mono.

mono.sinn: A single-channel signal (or a mix summed to one channel).
mono.eingriff: sum the bus to mono for the compatibility check; collapse a stereo source.

dry.messgroesse: Ratio of direct to reverberant energy; send level / reverb amount.
dry.eingriff: lower the reverb send or the wet/dry control, shorten decay.

wet.sinn: Dominated by the effect's reverberant signal.
wet.messgroesse: Ratio of reverberant to direct energy; decay time.
wet.eingriff: raise the send, lengthen decay, add early reflections.
wet.beleg: Senior 3rd ed, p. 285 (same passage, "wet versus dry")

clean.messgroesse: Low THD / no clipping or saturation artefacts.
clean.eingriff: reduce drive, gain or input level; bypass the saturator.

dirty.sinn: The harsh class of distortion: overloaded rather than characterful.
dirty.messgroesse: High harmonic distortion, hard clipping, broadband noise.
dirty.eingriff: raise drive/clip; the opposite direction of "clean".

evolving.sinn: Timbre that changes over the duration of the sound.
evolving.messgroesse: Spectral flux; variation of the spectral centroid over time.
evolving.eingriff: slow LFO/modulation of filter or wavetable, longer envelopes, granular movement.

aggressive.sinn: Hard, forward edge with many high inharmonic partials.
aggressive.messgroesse: High inharmonicity plus high-frequency partial energy.
aggressive.eingriff: reduce inharmonic content (ring mod, FM index), tame 2–5 kHz, soften attack.

smooth.sinn: Free of fast roughness; no rapid amplitude fluctuation in critical bands.
smooth.messgroesse: Low roughness: little envelope modulation in the 15–300 Hz region.
smooth.eingriff: reduce modulation depth (chorus, tremolo), lower distortion, tame 15–300 Hz modulation.

deep.sinn: Weight in the low end, heard as the far pole of luminance.
deep.messgroesse: Low spectral centroid plus low-frequency energy; the "deep" pole of brilliant–deep.
deep.eingriff: low-shelf up below ~100 Hz; high-shelf slightly down.

airy.sinn: Openness in the top octave above ~10 kHz.
airy.messgroesse: Energy above 10 kHz; also the "fuzzy/airy" pole of a density factor.
airy.eingriff: high-shelf up above 10 kHz (low Q), gentler than a "presence" boost.

tight.sinn: Low end with a short decay and no subsonic rumble.
tight.messgroesse: Little energy below ~30–40 Hz; fast decay; low crest on the sustained part.
tight.eingriff: high-pass 30–50 Hz, shorten the decay, gate/compress the tail.

thick.sinn: Dense, full body from many partials, often with movement.
thick.messgroesse: Inharmonicity and spectral-centroid fluctuation up, fundamental frequency down.
thick.eingriff: add low mids 150–500 Hz, detune/layer, saturate; lower the fundamental's dominance.

thin.sinn: Little body; the sound is narrow and hollow.
thin.messgroesse: Predominance of odd harmonics; weak low-order partials.
thin.eingriff: high-pass higher, cut 150–400 Hz; avoid odd-harmonic-only sources.

metallic.sinn: Ringing, bell-like hardness; listeners also use it for material, not only sound.
metallic.messgroesse: High inharmonic partial content in the upper register.
metallic.eingriff: reduce inharmonic/ring-mod content, notch the ringing partial, shorten decay.
metallic.beleg: Saitis & Weinzierl 2019, p. 138 (metallic/aggressive via phantom partials); p. 131

transparent.sinn: Without audible side effects of processing.
transparent.messgroesse: Absence of artefacts (no audible pitch-shift smearing, no pumping).
transparent.eingriff: smaller processing amounts, offline instead of real-time tools.

subtle.sinn: A small degree of an effect; low intensity.
subtle.messgroesse: Small parameter delta, low wet amount, small gain change.
subtle.eingriff: reduce the amount rather than changing the device.
